method: Independent native-vowel F0 shape comparison: WordBoundary target + >=60ms affricate offset; first contiguous voiced run >=4 frames ending no later than boundary+40ms.10 resampled semitone points, relative first3point mean; Euclidean shape distance with strict all-reference LOO, no dropping references/no global utterance pitch normalization/no listening or ASR. All pitch-floor sensitivity variants retained. This method is exploratory and cannot certify when reference controls or voicing fail.
